name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for wood siding restoration in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for wood siding restoration in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor in the Bay Area, look for one with specific experience in wood siding restoration. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they meet California state requirements. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolio of completed projects. A reputable contractor should also provide a clear, detailed estimate that outlines all services, materials, and timelines. Local expertise with Bay Area weather patterns is also a plus for ensuring durable results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed and insured contractors with wood siding restoration experience, good references, and detailed estimates, especially those with local Bay Area expertise.
